meta.name: apex-recon
meta.description: Engineering lead reconnaissance — inventory the project before planning. Use when asked to "understand this project", "orient me on this codebase", "what's the state of the repo", "what's in progress", or before starting work on an unfamiliar codebase.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速盘点项目状态，了解代码库全貌
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开始开发前快速理解一个不熟悉的代码库。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly inventory project state and understand the codebase before planning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly get up to speed with an unfamiliar codebase before starting work.

howto.what: Claude 会扮演工程领导角色，在规划前全面盘点项目：检测环境、梳理技术栈与项目结构、检查 Git 历史与活跃分支、评估测试与 CI/CD 状态，最后输出一份简要的工程侦察报告。
howto.when: 当你要求“了解这个项目”、“梳理代码库”、“查看仓库状态”或“正在做什么”，或者开始接手不熟悉的代码库时，Claude 会自动触发侦察流程。

say.text: 帮我梳理一下这个项目的结构和状态。
say.note: 触发完整的工程侦察流程。

say.text: 看看当前仓库有哪些活跃分支和未提交更改。
say.note: 聚焦活跃工作部分的盘点。

say.text: 评估这个项目的技术健康状况。
say.note: 触发健康信号评估（测试、CI/CD、文档等）。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an engineering lead to inventory the project before planning: it detects the environment, maps tech stack and project structure, checks Git history and active branches, assesses test coverage and CI/CD state, and outputs a concise reconnaissance report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'understand this project', 'orient me on this codebase', 'what's the state of the repo', 'what's in progress', or before starting work on an unfamiliar codebase.

say_en.text: Give me an overview of this project's structure and status.
Show me active branches and uncommitted changes.
Assess the technical health of this repo.
